sections.p: TOGETHER helps people grow together through goals, groups, challenges, courses and shared sessions. The app is currently free.
Register with accurate information and keep your password safe. One account per person. You are responsible for activity on your account.
Users under 18 may only join courses by verified teachers. You declare your age group once; false information is not allowed.
No violence, hate, harassment, sexual content, illegal content, spam, or sharing others' private information without consent. Violating content may be removed and accounts suspended.
Long-press posts, comments, profiles, groups or reviews to report them. You can block users. Reports are reviewed by our team.
You keep ownership of what you post. You allow us to show it to members of the relevant group inside the app.
Delete your account any time from Profile → Delete account. Your profile, goals, XP, groups you own and posts are permanently removed.
We may update these terms and will notify you in the app about important changes.
Email or phone number, name, username, age group (18+ or not, never your birth date), interests, and the goals, posts, comments, attachments, group and course activity you create.
To run the service, suggest groups that fit you, calculate progress (XP, level, streak), keep the community safe and review reports.

Your name and username are visible to members of your groups. Group posts and attachments are visible only to that group's members. Your goals, XP and interests are visible only to you. Reviews of public courses are public.
Data is stored on Supabase servers (Seoul, South Korea). Access is enforced at the database level with Row Level Security.
We do not sell your data or use it for advertising. We only share it with authorities when required by law.
You can edit your profile, change your interests and permanently delete your account.
We do not store the birth date of users under 18, and they can only join courses by verified teachers.
